assumptions.thermal_model: TI JEDEC board, not this layout; physical thermal measurements required

conditional_checks.name: TPS7A24 analog output budget inside ADS1299 recommended 4.75-5.25V
TPS7A24 digital output budget inside ADS1299 recommended 1.8-3.6V
Conditional input exceeds nominal+0.5V regulation test boundary
AVDD upper direct output capacitance below 50uF effective limit
40mA AFE budget below 100mA fuse hold at 23C
Bounded low-energy 10.2V fault with one series resistor short below TI 10mA injection limit
Bounded DC fault resistor dissipation below nominal 0.125W rating
Ideal SPI frame fits sample period

open_items: Effective minimum capacitance, cold/aged startup and stability measurements required
C29 must retain >=10uF at 4.5V including temperature/tolerance/aging
TPS7A24 noise/overshoot and ADC PSRR must be assessed in assembled board
Battery limits are assumptions, not discharge limits or an automatic cutoff
Nano branch protection, VIN radio-burst droop and interference require validation
BAV199 does not guarantee rail +/-0.3V clamping: TI internal clamps may conduct first
Injection-current calculation does not prove rails can sink current or establish acceptable body current
Power-off analog and GPIO injection can back-power rails and violate LDO VOUT <= VIN+0.3V; no live inputs with board off
20k input paths allow hundreds of microamps in a rail-to-contact fault; not a qualified body protection design
Bias resistor fault bounds, aggregate leakage, cable compensation and ESD tests remain open
No mains, defibrillator or IEC patient-protection compliance claim
